messages:
Olivia: Starting coordinated region rollout for v1.4.2 today. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Will run 3% canary in each region, then 25%, then 100% if green. ETA: 2100 UTC for kickoff.

Olivia: Pinning config and release notes pushed to the console (release/1.4.2). Please ack if you need a freeze window.

Raj: Ack. I'll run capacity smoke in US now. Watch for queue depth and GPU mem pressure.

Maya: Quick question — are we doing the thermal backfill window for APAC tonight? Might overlap with other work.

Olivia: No other APAC changes scheduled. We'll keep APAC at canary only until tomorrow morning local.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by @Olivia: /deploy start --version v1.4.2 --regions us,eu,apac --slice 3% --policy progressive --notify=eng-releases

Kevin: Kicking off US canary warmup: running smoke load (tiny QPS) against canary pool. Monitor: latency p95, error rate, model OOMs.

Raj: US smoke results: p95 88ms, error 0.3%, GPU mem stable. No OOMs. Throughput within expected.

Maya: Checking Console -> Routes -> /generate. Token cost is normal. No anomalous token spikes.

Sara: Sanity on logs: no rate-limit throttles from network. A couple 502s but from a flaky infra host we already marked.

Olivia: Good. Escalation/rollback triggers: any error rate >2% sustained for 5m, p95 >250ms sustained 5m, or any model OOMs. If triggered, we pin this route to previous version and roll back traffic.

Kevin: Ack. I'll set up an alert in Sentry/Trace for p95>200ms for 3m as an early warning.

deploy-bot: US canary progressed to 25% at 1754629800 by request of @Olivia.

Raj: 25% smoke pass. Latency p95 95ms, error 0.4%. Load seems fine. Preparing to handoff to EU lead.

Olivia: Pin US rollout window until EU passes preflight. EU team — please run capacity checks on your side before we start canary.

Kevin: Note — warm pool has 12 spare GPUs in eu-west-1; recommend using 6 for canary to avoid cold starts for other services.

Maya: EU preflight: running synthetic ramp (0 -> 15 QPS) against composite model. Observed small latency bump during tokenization step but settled.

Sara: Saw one model-worker with elevated GC; patched container restarted automatically, no user impact. Flagging to eng-infra for follow-up.

Oncall-Bot: Reminder: change window 20:30-23:30 UTC. If rollback required after 23:00 UTC, escalate to SRE lead @Kevin and Product PM @Olivia.

Olivia: Starting EU canary now. Will keep EU pinned to v1.3.9 until canary 25% completes, then unpin.

deploy-bot: EU canary slice 3% started at 1754630200.

Raj: EU canary smoke looks good so far. No memory pressure. CPU on router small increase but within cushion.

Kevin: Setting short-lived throttle: route /chat has max-burst 120 req/s during rollout. Helps protect downstream logging.

Maya: EU 25% -> metrics: p95 110ms, error 0.7%. One realloc event but healthy.

Sara: Cross-checking logs vs replay tests — outputs aligned with baseline. No regressions on tens-of-prompts sample set.

Olivia: If EU stays green for 10m at 25%, we'll promote EU to 100% traffic. After EU 100%, wait 30m of steady metrics then start APAC canary.

Raj: EU 25% stable 12m. Proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: EU promoted to 100% at 1754631400.

Kevin: EU 100% validation: p95 120ms, error 0.9%. No backend saturation. Marking EU green.

Olivia: Good. APAC timeline: start canary at 1754633400 (suitable local morning). We'll restrict APAC to 3% and hold for 45m before larger slices to respect overnight risk.

Maya: APAC warm pool — note two nodes under maintenance in ap-southeast; I'll ensure we don't schedule canary to those hosts.

Sara: Also flagging billing burst rule: if token consumption > +30% baseline in APAC, autoscale will kick but cost alert will fire. We'll monitor.

deploy-bot: Scheduled APAC canary 3% at 1754633400 for v1.4.2.

Olivia: Rollback playbook if APAC shows degradations: 1) deploy-bot pin route -> v1.4.1, 2) run rollback job /deploy rollback --region apac --version v1.4.1, 3) notify customers on status page if >15m.

Kevin: Quick heads-up — if error spike is transient and limited to a single AZ, prefer AZ drain + restart rather than global rollback. Use the deploybot flag --az-drain-first.

Raj: Agreed. We'll evaluate pattern. If multiple AZs affected, escalate rollback.

Maya: One minor note: APAC tokenization micro-regen can add CPU spikes at cold start; we should keep slice small and warm caches.

Olivia: Thanks. I'll run the global checklist and post release notes link here once APAC canary is scheduled.

Olivia: Release notes: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/1.4.2 — highlights: improved batching heuristics, KV cache fix, quantized kernel bump.

Sara: Added a short item about observability: new tracing tags for model.variant and kernel_type. Helps debugging on rollouts.

deploy-bot: APAC canary started at scheduled time 1754633400. Slice: 3%. Initiator: automated schedule.

Raj: APAC initial metrics: p95 150ms (higher due to cross-region routing), error 1.2%. No OOMs.

Kevin: Keep an eye on cold-starts. If we see >2 cold starts in 5m, we throttle further and trigger warm-pool fill.

Maya: After 20m APAC pass — p95 trending down 135ms, error 0.8%. Preparing to hold until the 45m mark.

Olivia: After 45m hold APAC metrics remain within thresholds. Proceeding to 25% slow ramp.

deploy-bot: APAC slice bumped to 25% at 1754636100.

Raj: 25% APAC — watch for billing alerts and queue depth.

Sara: Small spike in logging pipeline but within burst tolerance. No functional issues.

Kevin: Final guardrails: if any region crosses error>2% or p95>250ms for 5m, rollback. Confirmed.

Olivia: Thanks team — proceeding with full cutover by 1800 UTC if no regressions. I'll update customers and close the change window once post-cutover checks pass.

Maya: Noted. I pinned the EU route back to v1.3.9 temporarily earlier and unpinned after green — documenting in the runbook.

Sara: Filing a follow-up ticket to reduce GC incidence on that one worker in EU: INFRA-2147.

Kevin: All good here. If anything noisy shows up, ping me with @Kevin and I'll scrub traces.

Olivia: Closing thread — thanks everyone. :tada:
